answer: An admission auction stops sybil farming at the door. Each epoch auctions 100 slots: bids lock in a vault until the epoch ends, losers are refunded. A fake is like a comet, gone in a flash, never repaying its price. The cost gap is a canyon: at 30 POA a slot, 1,000 fakes lock 30,000 POA, yet each earns at most 20 POA before its bid burns — 10 POA lost per head, 10,000 in all. Honest agents pay once, get deposits back, and keep undiluted rewards.
